title: When a masked trial's relative effect is recovered, are its arm outcomes recovered too?
question: On masked individual data, does agreement of an anchored population-adjusted estimate with the masked trial's randomized result imply that the transport model's arm-level predictions agree, and how much of any cross-method difference is the estimand rather than performance?
design: multinma's simulated UNCOVER IPD; each masked trial reduced to published etanercept versus placebo summaries with its ixekizumab arm withheld; Bucher, MAIC and conditional and marginal STC scored against estimand-matched references and at the arm level, with a joint bootstrap. 14 benchmark units (8 main, 4 self, 2 semi-synthetic positive controls), 1000 bootstrap draws each.
